title: Nanolignin–polypyrrole nanocomposites: synthesis, electrical properties, and their performance in energy conversion applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29149-29159
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04454E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ebtesam H. A. Eladgham, Mona H. Abdel Rehim, Gamal Turky
A novel class of NL-PPy nanocomposites is synthesized via an in situ oxidative polymerization method. The electrical properties of the material and its performance as a redox-active electrolyte in dye-sensitized solar cells were studied.
